dates.note: Day numbers count whole days from the import day: -14 is 14 days before the import, 42 is 42 days after. The Jira JSON importer accepts relative past and future dates (proven in M0c and in the 31 Oct 2026 future-date check).

epics.summary: In-app checkout for the mobile app

expectedEvidence.expect: "Refund status endpoint in gateway v3" (PLT, To Do, unassigned, 5 days overdue) blocks "Refund to the original payment method from the order page" in Checkout v2 launch.
4 of 5 comparable epics that had work blocked by PLT work items finished late.

Wallet top-up finished 42 days late; its work item "Top up the wallet balance from a saved card" was blocked by "Credit and debit API for stored balances", which was resolved 28 days after its own due date.
5 of 6 comparable epics with a due date finished late, by a median of 21 days (from 12 to 42 days).
expectedEvidence.note: The median, minimum and maximum are taken over the epics that finished late.

expectedEvidence.expect: Wallet top-up was due on day -140 and finished on day -98, 42 days late.
Delivery slot selection at checkout was due on day -45 and finished on day -15, 30 days late.
In-app checkout for the mobile app was due on day -230 and finished on day -209, 21 days late.

plantedRisks.name: The plan is shorter than history

expectedEvidence.expect: Comparable epics took a median of 77 days from start to done (8 epics, 2 of them without a due date).
Checkout v2 launch is planned for 56 days (started on day -14, due on day 42); 7 of 8 comparable epics took longer than 56 days.
Checkout v2 launch started with 15 work items and has gained 6 since, 40% more; it now has 21.
Comparable epics gained a median of 40% more work items after they started (8 epics, from 20% to 60%).

plantedRisks.name: One person is spread thin

expectedEvidence.expect: The backend person has 14 open work items in total, 6 of them in this epic; the median for the 5 people on this epic is 3. They also have open work items in 2 other epics in progress: Payment gateway API v3 (PLT), Gift cards at checkout (CHK).
5 of 17 open work items in this epic are unassigned.

plantedRisks.note: Counts are seeded work items only. On a live site each person also has the open work items they already had (assign-personas.mjs prints them and stops above 5).

decoys.name: Resolved platform blocker
decoys.mustNotAppear: Any open-blocker evidence or reason that presents pf-plt-e03-02 "Gateway v3 client library for internal services" (resolved) as an open blocker of bk-chk-e11-05.

decoys.name: Busy past, light present
decoys.mustNotAppear: A load reason about the mobile person, or any count that treats their 47 done work items as open (their open total is 2).
